title: psyllium erectum
intro: Psyllium erectum, commonly known as Indian rhubarb or Plantago erecta, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is rich in soluble dietary fiber, which provides numerous health benefits, including promoting digestive regularity, reducing constipation, and lowering cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium erectum include acting as a gentle laxative, soothing digestive issues, and supporting the absorption of nutrients. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
